items.title: The Koszul complex of a product is the cone of a map between two Koszul complexes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma expresses the Koszul complex attached to a module map extended by multiplication by a product as the cone of a map between the complexes attached to the extensions by the two factors. The proof uses the earlier identification of each of the three complexes with the cone of multiplication by the corresponding element on the Koszul complex of the original map, and then invokes the abstract statement comparing the cones for a product with a map between the cones for the two factors.
